detail: The acceptance criterion is to repeat all the Steps to Reproduce. Step 5 opens My orders for the same newly placed order in an Asia/Tokyo browser, and TC-06 stops at step 4; TC-02 checks Tokyo only on a seeded order. Add to TC-06: open a second browser context with timezoneId 'Asia/Tokyo', sign in as alice, open My orders, and assert the order's Date equals the same instant (parsed from the Chicago text) formatted in Asia/Tokyo as MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss, including the calendar date.

The test captions 'after' and the UTC comparison and highlights the cell with 'not 11/16/2026 18:21:17 UTC', but frames 04, 06 and 07 show no caption or highlight label. Only 'before' and the local time 12:21:17 are visible, so the video never shows the not-UTC claim or the end of the time window. Highlight labels are missing in every case's frames, which points to the recording helper rather than this test.
